title: Signal Garden — Bioluminescent Ecosystem Synth

checks.name: Static file:// contract
checks.command:
python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; html=Path('index.html').read_text(); js=Path('garden.js').read_text(); assert 'garden.js' in html and 'garden.css' in html and 'scene-desc' in html; needles=['mulberry32','DT = 1 / 60','plantBeacon','paintNutrient','globalPulse','loadPreset','prefers-reduced-motion'];
[assert n in js for n in needles]; print('ok')"
checks.details: Entrypoint loads only local CSS/JS, includes an accessible scene description, and contains the required simulation and interaction hooks.

checks.name: No remote runtime references
checks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text=''.join(p.read_text(errors='ignore') for p in Path('.').iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.html','.js','.css','.md'}); hits=[f for f in ['http://','https://','cdn.','unpkg','jsdelivr','googleapis'] if f in text]; print(hits or 'none')"
checks.details: HTML, CSS, JS, and README contain no http(s), CDN, or font/network endpoints.

checks.name: Seeded world, HUD, interactions, 30s attractor
checks.command: node (headless canvas stub) regenerate/snapshot, plantBeacon, globalPulse, loadPreset, 1800 fixed steps
checks.details: Same seed reproduced the same initial bloom layout; different seeds differed. Pulse/beacon/preset paths ran. After 30s at 60 Hz on Tide Garden, population stayed healthy (26 blooms, 62 drifters, 6 hunters, energy 21.77) under caps. HUD bloom count matched live population.

summary: Direct-open Canvas 2D bioluminescent garden with blooms, drifters, and hunters; seeded fixed-step sim; pointer current, beacons, nutrient paint, pulse/pause/reseed/presets; optional muted-by-default Web Audio.
